paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is currently 6.17, with a change of -3.59% from the prior close and 1.98% over the last 22 sessions. There have been 2 new news items in the last 24 hours.

Recent news headlines include "Fermi sinks after receiving subpoena tied to Project Matador" from Seeking Alpha and "Fermi Receives Subpoena From Eastern District of New York Over Project Matador" from marketscreener.com, both of which report on the company receiving a subpoena related to the Project Matador data center campus.

There have been various SEC filings, including a 10-Q form reporting a net loss for the second quarter of 2026, and an 8-K form announcing the appointment of Lee McIntire as the new Chief Executive Officer, effective August 11, 2026, with a disclosed annualized base salary.
